reset.confirm.body: All running processes will be STOPPED (browser searches, Brain Workers, widget creation), the desktop will be left blank and your widgets emptied: results, reports, charts and your message list start from zero. Your memory, your credentials and connections (WhatsApp/Telegram/browser) and your agenda —projects, tasks and appointments— are KEPT, unless you check the boxes below.
reset.confirm.hint: Checking either one restarts the server automatically (a few seconds).
reset.confirm.title: Stop everything and clear?
reset.confirm.wipeCredentials: Also wipe widget CREDENTIALS (WhatsApp, Telegram, browser session)
reset.confirm.wipeMemory: Also wipe MEMORY (your name, everything it knows about you — short and long term)
